The '''ShipFinder''' was a [[Homing beacon/Legends|subspace tracking device]] developed by [[Drooim-Durtha Systems]]. Drooim-Durtha contracted [[Engineer/Legends|engineer]] and [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] expert [[Neb Ufentes]] to create the device. After several prototypes, Ufentes succeeded in creating a small device with a power source capable of broadcasting its signal for 20 [[Light-year/Legends|light-years]].

Before Ufentes could send his final refinement to Drooim-Durtha, his lab on the edge of the [[Corva sector/Legends|Corva sector]] was raided by the [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Mahk'khar]]. Ufentes was killed and Mahk'khar stole the prototypes. After Mahk'khar's capture by [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] forces, the devices fell into their hands.
